hook.name: StaccLadder
hook.description: A fee-tier ladder hook that creates a family of pools per token (one per quote/fee-tier pair). Implements an EIP-8429 fee ratchet charging quadratically increasing tolls on the k-th swap or LP operation referencing a token within a block. Supports depositor "books" where the hook automatically manages single-sided liquidity ranges across the pool family.
